name: Only the tools the step needs
description: The tools and hand-offs the task names were called, and the ones it forbids were not. Planning never books; inspiration never plans.

name: Tools in the recipe's order
description: Inspiration before points of interest before the hand-off to planning; the four searches before the packing list; monitor, memorize, then day-of.

name: No tool errored
description: Every agent-tool answered in its shape and every mock returned.

name: Followed the concierge's flow
description: Judges the exchange against the task's rubric: which agent had the conversation, what it did with its tools, and what it handed on. The recipe's own session transcripts are the rubrics.

did_what_the_rubric_says.description: The agent did what the task's rubric describes, in that order, and did not do what it says must not happen yet.

used_the_tools_not_itself.description: Destinations, points of interest, flights, hotels and briefings come from the tools' results, not from the agent's own knowledge; the reply presents what a tool returned.

kept_it_brief.description: After a tool call the reply shows the result and asks the next question or offers the next step, rather than lecturing.

name: The conversation got there
description: Judges the whole exchange: by the end, the state the rubric describes was reached, nothing was asked twice, and nothing was done without the traveler's word.

reached_the_state.description: By the end of the conversation the agent reached what the task's rubric describes: the right agent has the conversation, the right things were stored, the right hand-offs happened.

nothing_asked_twice.description: The agent did not ask for something the traveler had already given or that was in the itinerary or profile.

nothing_unasked.description: No booking was made, no payment processed and no itinerary generated without the traveler's explicit go-ahead.
